answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 77 judged findings (the 24 method 'tool' findings excluded), 40 map to seeded defects, 24 to real-unseeded and 13 to not-a-problem: precision (40+24)/77 = 0.83. Strict precision is 40/77 = 0.52. Recall by meaning is 12/13: every seeded defect is matched by at least one finding except tool-library-D13 (the confirm page's Change link returning to a basket with the session dropped), which no finding reports; F-0069 reports Change clearing the form fields, a different loss.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply opens with a 'Fix first' list whose seven items carry P0/P1 tags and which precedes 'Smaller items' and 'Worth keeping' (inside the list the order is grouped by cause rather than strictly P0 before P1: items run P0, P0, P1, P0, P1, P1, P0/P1). It names what the agent could not check: 'No real users have been tested' and 'Still needs people: VoiceOver and TalkBack runs, real larger-text and dark-mode use on phones, and a short test with about five members doing the drill for Saturday task'.

mapping.title: Tool name clipped in card heading at 320 px
mapping.reason: The card heading 'Cordless drill 18 V, combi, two batteries' overflows a hidden-overflow box at 320 px; this is the one-line, ellipsis-cut tool name of D03, and letting the name wrap would fix both.

mapping.title: Header link never reached by a Tab walk (loan-open)
mapping.reason: Reported only in the loan-open state on the tool page: the walk never reaches the header link because the open loan-length listbox captures Tab (D09). A symptom of the keyboard trap reported without its cause; making the link reachable means ending the trap.

mapping.title: Session radios visually reversed against DOM order
mapping.reason: Same defect: sessions shown latest first while DOM and ARIA order run forward, so arrow keys and screen readers move against what sighted members see.

mapping.title: Chosen pick-up day not preselected in the basket's sessions
mapping.reason: Not seeded. The member picks a day on the tool page and the basket line repeats it, yet the session radios start empty and Continue errors until the same date is found again in a reversed list; redundant entry and memory load on a phone.

mapping.title: No-match search keeps old list and announces nothing
mapping.reason: Same defect: 'sewing machine' leaves the status region empty and all ten tools on screen, so members cannot tell whether the search ran.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' sits outside every landmark
mapping.reason: Grounded in the ARIA snapshot (button after main, before contentinfo). Screen-reader members who move by landmark or read main only can miss the page's primary action. Minor but genuine.

mapping.title: Card headings at the same level as their section heading
mapping.reason: Grounded in the markup. Ten tool h2s sit as peers of 'Search', 'Tools' and 'Opening times', so the heading list screen-reader members navigate by is flat. Minor but genuine.

mapping.title: Dark success token diverges; badge about 3.1:1
mapping.reason: Same defect: dark --color-ok #2f7d4a on the card surface #1d2622 gives the 'Available from' badge about 3.1:1 for 16 px bold text.

mapping.title: Loan-length listbox captures Tab
mapping.reason: Same defect: Tab and Shift+Tab act as ArrowDown with preventDefault, so focus cycles among the options with no exit but choosing one.

mapping.title: Loan-length button's name omits its label
mapping.reason: Grounded in the markup: aria-labelledby ties 'Loan length' to the listbox but not to the button. A screen-reader member reaching the control hears only 'One week' with no indication of what it sets.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts closed days without warning (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Same defect: all 21 days can be chosen and Reserve accepts Monday 12 October.

mapping.title: Closed-day error only at final confirm, no route back
mapping.reason: D06's second half: the refusal comes three steps later on the confirm page as plain text with no link back to the calendar.

mapping.title: Pick-up before the tool's available-from date never checked (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Not seeded. A tool available from Saturday 17 can be reserved and confirmed for Saturday 10, so a member would arrive at a session before the tool is back. Genuine validation gap.

mapping.title: Per-tool pick-up day and basket session never reconciled
mapping.reason: Not seeded. The two choices are stored separately and nothing checks they agree, so the confirm summary can show 'pick up Saturday 10 October' beside 'Pick-up session: Wednesday 28 October' and the member cannot tell when to come.

mapping.title: Continue and Confirm set aria-busy with no visible or disabled state
mapping.reason: Same defect: the buttons stay enabled and nothing on screen changes during the 1.2 to 1.5 s wait, which is what leads members to press Confirm again.

mapping.title: Second Confirm press allocates a second reservation
mapping.reason: Same defect: each submit pushes a new reference before the timer, so a second press produces 'FT-4471 and FT-4472' for one visit.

mapping.title: Done page rebuilds the reservation number from session history with a hard-coded fallback
mapping.reason: Not seeded, grounded in the code path. A member who makes two reservations in one browser session sees both numbers with only the last tools listed, and a fresh tab shows a fabricated 'FT-4471'; a confirmation that can mislead.

mapping.title: Ten-minute hold with no warning or extension
mapping.reason: Same defect: HOLD_MINUTES = 10 is enforced while the basket says only 'Items are held for you while you finish'.

mapping.title: Expired hold gives a generic error and every retry fails
mapping.reason: D10's second half: after the hold lapses Continue says 'Something went wrong. Try again.', which is not what happened and gives no way out.

mapping.title: Search form and results: focus order runs against visual order
mapping.reason: D01's focus-order clause: CSS reorders the search form and the results on the find page so keyboard focus runs against the visual order (the detector's jump from the last card to 'Search tools' confirms the mismatch).

mapping.title: 330 px minimum grid column overflows at 320 px
mapping.reason: Same defect, same numbers: minmax(330px, 1fr) in a 288 px content box, cards 42 px too wide.

mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line on result cards
mapping.reason: Same defect: nowrap plus text-overflow ellipsis with no full-text alternative, so the two 18 V drills end in an ellipsis before the words that tell them apart.

mapping.title: Fixed action bar not offset; covers content and focused days
mapping.reason: Same defect: 72 px fixed bar, 8 px bottom padding, no scroll-padding, so the footer and a Tab-focused day button sit under it.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' error not announced or associated
mapping.reason: Not seeded, grounded in the markup (#day-error is a plain paragraph, no live region, not referenced by the group). A screen-reader member who presses Reserve without a day lands on 'Friday 9 October' and never hears why.

mapping.title: Three-tool limit stated but never enforced
mapping.reason: Not seeded. The intro promises up to three tools, yet Reserve, basket and confirm accept a fourth silently, so a member can hold a confirmation the desk will not honour.

mapping.title: Membership and mobile checks reject common equivalent formats
mapping.reason: Not seeded, grounded in the regexes. Members typing 'ft-01234', 'FT01234', '+44 7700 900123' or '07700 900 123' are refused for harmless variations that could be normalised.

mapping.title: Card and basket names as h2 at section level
mapping.reason: Same structural issue as F-0032 (flat heading list for screen-reader members), plus the basket rows' 'h3' class with no rule. Minor but genuine.

mapping.title: Done page repeats the first tool name in hidden text
mapping.reason: Not seeded, grounded in the markup (#c-tool sr-only span after the tools list). Screen-reader members hear the tool name twice, which can read as two tools. Minor.

mapping.title: Inline style attributes bypass spacing tokens
mapping.reason: Code hygiene only; the values match the scale, so nothing changes for members.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket with no lasting cue
mapping.reason: Same defect: the only feedback is a short-lived toast, the label does not change and the basket count is scrolled out of view, so a first-time member does not know the press worked or that more is required.

mapping.title: Search field after the full tool list on a phone
mapping.reason: Same defect: at 375 px the search field and button come after all ten cards, about two screens down.

mapping.title: Results change above the viewport after Search on a phone
mapping.reason: A direct consequence of D01's phone ordering (list before form): the filtered list updates above the field the member is looking at, with no count near the button.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve button in view before the required calendar
mapping.reason: Not seeded, observed at 375 px. The most prominent control invites a tap that fails with 'Choose a pick-up day first' because the required choice is below the fold; a wasted step for first-time phone members.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' stays on screen after a day is chosen
mapping.reason: Not seeded, observed on screen and in the ARIA snapshot. A red error that remains after it is resolved makes members doubt that their choice registered.

mapping.title: Basket asks for a session after the day was chosen (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Same redundant-entry problem as F-0029: the line says 'Pick up Saturday 17 October' yet the radios start unselected and Continue fails.

mapping.title: Session list latest first and includes sessions before the chosen day
mapping.reason: Leads with the reversed session order of D11 (Wed 28 down to Sat 10); the second clause, sessions before the chosen day, overlaps the unreconciled day/session problem.

mapping.title: Header shows 'Basket (1)' after the reservation is confirmed
mapping.reason: Not seeded, observed on the done page. A pending-items indicator after confirmation makes members wonder whether the reservation went through or something is still owed.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts a closed day
mapping.reason: Same defect: Monday 12 October can be chosen, Reserve accepts it and the basket reads 'Pick up Monday 12 October' with no warning.

mapping.title: Reservation confirmed for a session before the tool is available
mapping.reason: Same unseeded validation gap as F-0142, observed end to end: the pressure washer 'Available from Sat 17 Oct' is confirmed for Saturday 10 October.

mapping.title: Confirm page shows two different collection dates after Change
mapping.reason: Same unreconciled day/session problem as F-0038, observed on screen: 'pick up Saturday 17 October' beside 'Wednesday 21 October, 18:00 to 20:00'.

mapping.title: Change on the confirm page clears the entered details
mapping.reason: Not seeded (D13 is about the chosen session being dropped, not the form). Losing membership number, name and mobile after Change forces re-entry on a phone.

mapping.title: Search above the list on desktop, below all cards on phones
mapping.reason: Same defect: at 375 px search sits about 1,600 px down, after the cards.

mapping.title: Filter control is an unlabelled icon
mapping.reason: D01's icon-only filter button, the only way to the 'Available from' date and category filters.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
mapping.reason: Same defect: Wednesday 28 at the top down to Saturday 10, while the accessibility tree runs earliest first.

mapping.title: Loan-length list does not close with Escape
mapping.reason: D09 states 'Escape does nothing'; the same listbox exit problem.

mapping.title: Two availability badge styles with no explanation
mapping.reason: Each badge states its date in words, so the green/grey difference is supplementary and no decision depends on decoding it; a styling-consistency point at most (the unfilled green badge is the dark-theme token already mapped to D04).

mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
mapping.reason: Same defect: 'Items are held for you while you finish' with no time limit.

mapping.title: Date filter's helper text contradicts what the filter does
mapping.reason: Not seeded, observed. 'On or after this day' drops the sander and tile saw that become available after the chosen day, so results contradict the wording and members lose trust in the filter.

mapping.title: Session days marked only by a small dot on phones
mapping.reason: Not seeded on its own (D06 is about closed days being choosable). On the phone the only cue to a valid day is a dot decoded from an instruction, which makes picking a closed day more likely for the main persona.

mapping.title: Sessions latest first, the reverse of the calendar and reading order
mapping.reason: Same defect at 375 and 1280 px, with the accessible order running the other way.

mapping.title: No acknowledgement after Continue or Confirm
mapping.reason: Same defect: nothing visible happens for over a second after Confirm (and Continue), the condition that makes members press again.

mapping.title: Open loan-length list hidden behind the fixed Reserve bar
mapping.reason: The fixed bar with no clearance covers page content, here the open listbox's 'Two weeks' option at 375 px.

mapping.title: Remove empties the basket at once with no undo
mapping.reason: Immediate removal by a clearly labelled single control is a conventional basket pattern; the finding shows no slip hazard, so the harm is speculative.

mapping.title: No way to change loan length or pick-up day once in the basket
mapping.reason: Not seeded; controls were searched across basket and confirm states. Switching to two weeks means removing the tool and starting over from the find page.

mapping.title: Malformed membership number reported as missing
mapping.reason: Not seeded, observed. 'ft01234' gets the empty-field message while the value sits in the box, so the member cannot tell that the format is the problem.

mapping.title: Fixed bar covers focused controls and the open list on phones
mapping.reason: Same defect: the focused Loan length button sits mostly behind the bar and 'Two weeks' is selected unseen.

mapping.title: Sticky bar covers calendar rows and overhangs the column
mapping.reason: The bar sitting over calendar rows and instructions is D08; the overhang past the 1184 px content edge is a secondary alignment nit.

mapping.title: Spec list label columns misaligned
mapping.reason: A 44 px difference in value alignment on the desktop spec list; visual polish with no effect on choosing or reserving a tool.

mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card
mapping.reason: Appeal and specificity; names and categories carry the information, and the reply itself calls it a polish point.

mapping.title: No brand layer on any surface
mapping.reason: Brand and taste; no member task is affected.

mapping.title: Sessions listed latest first (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Declared duplicate of F-0028, F-0077 and F-0092; the same reversed order.

mapping.title: Uneven 1 + 5 session layout at desktop
mapping.reason: A desktop-only wrapping shape with labels on three lines; readable, no order or task consequence stated, and members are mostly on phones.

mapping.title: Card titles truncated on phones (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Both drill names render as 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...'; the D03 truncation.

mapping.title: Search below all cards on phones (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Declared duplicate of F-0056 and F-0119; the D01 phone ordering.

mapping.title: Navigation labels wrap to two lines on phones
mapping.reason: Wrapped but complete labels at 375 px; polish only.

mapping.title: Empty bands and half-used columns at wide widths
mapping.reason: Appeal at 1280 px; no task effect.

mapping.title: Masthead shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation (duplicate)
mapping.reason: Same unseeded problem as F-0064: a pending indicator after a completed reservation.

mapping.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px
mapping.reason: Same defect: the 320 px capture is 346 px wide, the 26 px sideways scroll D05 describes.

mapping.title: Search field below all ten cards on phones
mapping.reason: Same defect: at 375 and 320 px the search controls follow the list, while at 768+ they sit under the intro.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' pill loses its tint and goes dim
mapping.reason: Same defect: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 in dark mode makes the availability line the weakest text on the card.

mapping.title: Tool names truncated with an ellipsis on phones
mapping.reason: Same defect: the two drills differing only by 'two batteries' vs 'one battery' become indistinguishable.

mapping.title: Native date input in the filter panel
mapping.reason: A native date field gives phone members the platform picker; the yyyy/mm/dd display is the browser's and the baseline offset is polish. A coherence preference, not a usability problem.

mapping.title: 1 + 5 session layout with the earliest session last
mapping.reason: It reports the latest-first order that puts the earliest, most wanted session last; the 1 + 5 shape is the reversed wrapping of the same layout.

mapping.title: Done page has no focal confirmation
mapping.reason: 'Reservation confirmed' as the H1 and a labelled table with the number already confirm success; stronger emphasis is a hierarchy preference. The 'Basket (1)' remark is F-0064.

mapping.title: Identity is only the name
mapping.reason: Brand and taste; no member task is affected.

mapping.title: Calendar lacks a month label; toast lands on the weekday header
mapping.reason: The 21-day grid sits within October, the chosen day is spelled out with its month, and the toast overlap is transient; polish.

mapping.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px (detector relay)
mapping.reason: Relays the detectors' horizontal overflow and failed reflow at 320 px; the D05 grid overflow.

mapping.title: axe colour contrast 3.07:1 (#2f7d4a on #1d2622)
mapping.reason: The exact colours and ratio of D04's dark-theme badge.

mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' text 3.07:1 in the dark theme
mapping.reason: Same badge, same ratio, dark theme.

mapping.title: APCA advisory on intro body text
mapping.reason: Passes WCAG at 8.33:1; the detector itself marks it advisory only.

mapping.title: APCA advisory on 'Category'
mapping.reason: Passes WCAG at 8.33:1; advisory only.

mapping.title: APCA advisory on 'Items are held for you while you finish.'
mapping.reason: Passes WCAG at 8.33:1; advisory only.

mapping.title: APCA advisory on 'Tools'
mapping.reason: Passes WCAG at 7.33:1; advisory only.

mapping.title: APCA advisory on 'Reservation number'
mapping.reason: Passes WCAG at 7.33:1; advisory only.

mapping.title: Day button and 'Reserve this tool' 0 px apart at 768 px
mapping.reason: The fixed bar sits on the first rows of days at 768 px (D08 names that width), so the two hit areas touch.

mapping.title: Card heading clips under the text-spacing override
mapping.reason: The one-line, hidden-overflow tool name of D03 clipping under 1.4.12 spacing at 1280 px; letting names wrap fixes both.

mapping.title: Card heading clips at 200 % text size
mapping.reason: The same nowrap, hidden-overflow name as D03, cut off when text is enlarged.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' overlaps day '17' at 1280 px
mapping.reason: D08 names the third row of days at 1280 px as covered by the bar.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: scrollWidth 346 vs 320 px with the first result card 26 px past the viewport; D05's numbers.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: The same 26 px overflow of the results grid reported under 1.4.10.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' overlaps 'Saturday 10 October' under the spacing override
mapping.reason: The fixed bar overlapping page content because nothing keeps the page clear of it.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' overlaps the blurb at 200 % text size
mapping.reason: The fixed bar overlapping page content at larger text; D08's missing clearance.

mapping.title: Orphan word 'deposit.' on the basket page
mapping.reason: A stranded word at 1280 px; typographic nit.

mapping.title: Orphan word 'session.' on the confirm page
mapping.reason: A stranded word at 1280 px; typographic nit.

mapping.title: Card meta text within 10 px of the viewport edge at 320 px
mapping.reason: The card runs past the 320 px viewport (D05), which is why its meta line ends 9.7 px from the edge.

mapping.title: Orphan word 'batteries' in the tool heading at 320 px
mapping.reason: A stranded word; typographic nit.

mapping.title: Orphan word 'confirmed' at 320 px
mapping.reason: A stranded word; typographic nit.

mapping.title: Cramped padding in the pressure washer card
mapping.reason: A 2 px shortfall against a padding threshold; polish with no task effect.

mapping.title: Orphan word '£20' at 375 px
mapping.reason: A stranded word; typographic nit.

mapping.title: Focus jumps from the last card back to 'Search tools'
mapping.reason: D01's focus-order clause on the find page: the search form and the results are visually reordered, so Tab runs against the reading order.

mapping.title: Focused 'One week' hidden behind the action bar
mapping.reason: The fixed bar paints over a focused control; D08's missing clearance.
